sections.heading: what this board *isn't*
sections.body:
Several threads carry stub handoffs with no state recorded, so what is genuinely unfinished in them is unknown rather than confirmed. A number of mission outcomes are triage rewrites rather than new work, which makes the board look busier than it is. No thread in the whole record contains evidence of a buyer reply, a price objection, or a collected payment, so every quality judgment across this portfolio is currently self-assessed.

220 more threads cleared the bar but sit below the 12-card ceiling and were not carded: health performance ip library, deep research, extract virtuoso mastery, deliverables, angle map listening engine v4 1, guides, teardown 1 fresh, global org sweep, god agent offer, readout os, dunford handshake haynes, godin marketing mind.

212 keys were seen but never declared a thread (no live handoff, no open mission, no finalized deliverable) — activity alone does not mint a mission.
